import json
from configkit import Config, loads, dumps
v1={'name':'demo','host':'localhost','port':8080,'enabled':False}
v2={'version':2,'service':{'name':'demo','endpoint':{'host':'localhost','port':8080}},'enabled':False}

with TemporaryDirectory() as td:

import json
from configkit import Config, loads, dumps
v1={'name':'demo','host':'localhost','port':8080,'enabled':False}
v2={'version':2,'service':{'name':'demo','endpoint':{'host':'localhost','port':8080}},'enabled':False}
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
import contextlib,io
from configkit.cli import main
with TemporaryDirectory() as td:
 p=Path(td)/'c.json';p.write_text(json.dumps(v1));before=p.read_bytes();out=io.StringIO()
 with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out): assert main(['migrate',str(p),'--dry-run'])==0
 assert json.loads(out.getvalue())==v2 and p.read_bytes()==before
 out=io.StringIO()
 with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out): assert main(['migrate',str(p)])==0
 assert json.loads(out.getvalue())==v2 and json.loads(p.read_text())==v2

name: caller_integration
code:
import json
from configkit import Config, loads, dumps
v1={'name':'demo','host':'localhost','port':8080,'enabled':False}
v2={'version':2,'service':{'name':'demo','endpoint':{'host':'localhost','port':8080}},'enabled':False}
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from configkit.service import export_config,inspect_config
from configkit.cli import main
import contextlib,io
with TemporaryDirectory() as td:
 source=Path(td)/'s';dest=Path(td)/'d';source.write_text(json.dumps(v2));before=source.read_bytes()
 expected={'name':'demo','address':'localhost:8080','enabled':False}
 assert export_config(source,dest)==expected
 assert inspect_config(dest)==expected and json.loads(dest.read_text())==v2
 assert source.read_bytes()==before
 out=io.StringIO()
 with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out): assert main(['show',str(dest)])==0
 assert json.loads(out.getvalue())==expected

code:
import json
from configkit import Config, loads, dumps
v1={'name':'demo','host':'localhost','port':8080,'enabled':False}
v2={'version':2,'service':{'name':'demo','endpoint':{'host':'localhost','port':8080}},'enabled':False}
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from configkit.store import save
from configkit.config.errors import ConfigError
with TemporaryDirectory() as td:
 p=Path(td)/'d';p.write_text('preserve')
 try: save(p,Config('demo','localhost',False))
 except ConfigError: pass
 else: raise AssertionError('invalid write accepted')
 assert p.read_text()=='preserve'
